name: snapdragon-mastodon-ui-e2e
description: Playwright + playwright-bdd e2e harness for the snapdragon-mastodon-ui federated remote (the Mastodon/Akkoma social surface). Copied from the proven snapdragon.games/e2e pattern and mirrors the merged wave-2b-1 harnesses (admin-ui#39, superadmin-appstore-ui#2, login-ui#19). Ships dark (wave 2b): every cluster-dependent scenario is @cluster-tagged so the suite compiles and discovers offline without a live stack.
